So if you "ended" in Upper Engine in the front half of the round, you had all the time in the world to slip down to Storage through the back stairs and kill Alice after I left her there at tick 16. Your route conveniently stops right before the kill window.

Third — and this is the big one — Frank's northern loop matches my early-game sightings. I saw Charlie and Eve at weapons ticks 4-5, then Charlie moved to security and electrical. Frank says he was bouncing through cafeteria and weapons. That's consistent with the foot traffic I observed up north. Your claim that "no one was up there" directly contradicts what I saw with my own eyes.

Frank found the body. I was demonstrably doing tasks on the east and south side. You're the one with the unaccounted-for back half of the round and a route that puts you one corridor away from Storage.

I'm voting Bob.
